name: open-desktop-authenticator
description: Open Desktop Authenticator — an open-source desktop authenticator for Steam, by MASTERPANEL LLC. A maintained successor to SDA.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run notices && electron-vite build
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --publish never
scripts.package:store: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win appx --publish never
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:integration
scripts.smoke:browser: electron-vite build && esbuild tools/smoke-system-login.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=out/smoke/system-login.js --log-level=error && node tools/run-electron-harness.mjs out/smoke/system-login.js && node tools/run-electron-harness.mjs tools/smoke-browser-chrome.mjs && esbuild tools/smoke-browser-window.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=out/smoke/browser-window.js --log-level=error && node tools/run-electron-harness.mjs out/smoke/browser-window.js
scripts.stress:browser: electron-vite build && esbuild tools/stress-browser.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=out/stress/browser.js --log-level=error && node tools/run-electron-harness.mjs out/stress/browser.js
